Alger, 13 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech): Algiers, September 13, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The new Rision Magic pocket thermal camera turns a smartphone into a technical diagnostic tool. This external accessory plugs directly into mobile devices to detect temperature variations.
Un outil de diagnostic thermique portabl: A portable thermal diagnostic tool for mobile devices
L'appareil Rision Magic se connecte via: The Rision Magic device connects via a USB-C port to iOS, Android, and Windows operating systems. Using it only requires installing a dedicated app, with no obligation to create a user account. This external accessory format avoids the need to recharge an extra battery, as power is supplied directly by the host phone.
Ce dispositif détecte les surchauffes de: This device detects wiring overheating, battery failures, or insulation defects. It also makes it possible to locate elements invisible behind partitions, such as piping, thanks to thermal differences. The app offers various display modes, including a combined hybrid mode called "AI BiSpectrix".
Sur le plan technique, l'appareil intègr: Technically, the device integrates a native 160 x 120 pixel sensor. QuadIR technology raises this resolution to 320 x 240 pixels to optimize diagnostic precision. The display benefits from a 25 Hz refresh rate to ensure video fluidity.
Aucune création de compte ni inscription: No account creation or registration required to use the dedicated app.
